name: asc-mcp
description: MCP server for App Store Connect. Ask Claude about releases, TestFlight, reviews and sales. Read-only by default.
long_description: MCP server for App Store Connect. Ask Claude about releases, TestFlight, reviews and sales. Read-only by default; anything public waits for your yes.

prompts.name: release_checklist
prompts.description: Walk an app version to App Review.

prompts.name: rejection_triage
prompts.description: Explain an App Review rejection and plan fixes.
prompts.text: ${arguments.app} was rejected. Explain why and plan the fixes.

prompts.name: translate_metadata
prompts.description: Translate store metadata into other locales.
prompts.text: Translate the App Store metadata of ${arguments.app} from ${arguments.from_locale} into ${arguments.to_locales}.

prompts.name: reply_to_reviews
prompts.text: Draft replies to reviews of ${arguments.app} since ${arguments.since}.

prompts.name: weekly_report
prompts.description: Summarize how an app did this week.
prompts.text: Give me a weekly report for ${arguments.app}.

asc_key_id.title: API key ID
asc_key_id.description: App Store Connect API key ID (Users and Access > Integrations).

asc_issuer_id.title: Issuer ID
asc_issuer_id.description: Team key issuer ID. Leave empty for an Individual API key.

asc_private_key_path.title: Private key (.p8)
asc_private_key_path.description: The AuthKey_XXXX.p8 file downloaded from App Store Connect.

asc_vendor_number.title: Vendor number
asc_vendor_number.description: Needed only for sales and finance reports (Payments and Financial Reports).

allow_writes.title: Allow writes
allow_writes.description: Expose write and destructive tools. Destructive actions still require plan/confirm.

toolsets.title: Toolsets
toolsets.description: Empty for the defaults, 'all', or e.g. '+signing,+monetization'.
